name: Rosemary and the Tale of Ivywood Manor
source:
A long time ago, in a small and quiet town, the Ivywood family tragically died in a mysterious fire. The cause of the fire was never determined.

Fast forward to 2023. It's Halloween night, and Rosemary, her best friend Autumn, and her younger brother Heath are going out trick or treating. Rosemary can't believe she has to babysit her brother tonight, when she should be able to be out having fun with all of her friends!

The night is going as planned, until Heath runs off into the forest, behind a burnt down house that they've never noticed before...

Will Rosemary and Autumn be able to find him? Will they make it out alive?
